name: IQ Test
title: IQ Test: Easy to Impossible 🧠 32 Logic Questions | How Smart Are You?
about: Logic puzzles, number patterns and brain teasers, from easy to impossible. How smart are you?
ar: اختبار ذكاء من السهل إلى المستحيل — هل أنت ذكي بما يكفي؟
fr: Test de QI du plus facile à l'impossible — es-tu vraiment intelligent ?
levels: Today is Monday. What day is it in 2 days?
Tom is taller than Sam. Sam is taller than Ben. Who is the shortest?
How many sides do 2 triangles have in total?
Odd one out: red, blue, apple, green
Apple is a fruit, not a color.
You pass the person in 2nd place in a race. What place are you in?
A farmer has 17 sheep. All but 9 run away. How many are left?
All BUT 9 run away, so 9 stay.
You get 3 pills, one every half hour. How long do they last?
A red house is made of red bricks. What is a greenhouse made of?
A greenhouse is made of glass!
What comes next? J, F, M, A, M, J, J, ?
5 machines make 5 toys in 5 minutes. How long do 100 machines take to make 100 toys?
Each machine makes 1 toy in 5 minutes.
What comes next? O, T, T, F, F, S, S, ?
9 is the only one that is not a prime number.
A brick weighs 1 kg plus half a brick. How much does one brick weigh?
Half a brick = 1 kg, so a brick = 2 kg.
Water lilies double every day and cover a lake in 48 days. When is the lake half covered?
One day before: they double on day 48!
Read it out loud: three 1s, two 2s, one 1!
It's 3:15. What is the angle between the clock hands?
The hour hand has moved a quarter of the way to 4.
A dad is 4 times as old as his son. In 20 years, he'll be twice as old. How old is the son now?
Rearrange CIFAIPC to get an ocean.
Rearrange the letters C, I, F, A, I, P, C to get the name of an ocean.
How many times does the digit 9 appear from 1 to 100?
How many squares are on a chessboard (all sizes)?
Sally has 3 brothers. Each brother has 2 sisters. How many sisters does Sally have?
The 2 sisters are Sally and one more girl!
A bat and a ball cost $1.10. The bat costs $1 more than the ball. How much is the ball?
A bat and a ball cost one dollar and ten cents. The bat costs one dollar more than the ball. How much is the ball?
